content:
Laredo Public Health is hosting a Memory Café “Recordando” gathering on Friday, November 13, at 10 a.m. at the Santa Rita Recharge Center, 301 Castro Urdiales Ave.

The free event is open to seniors, caregivers, and people living with mild memory loss. Attendees can socialize, share stories, and take part in brain-boosting activities in a welcoming, supportive setting, according to the department.

The gathering is part of Laredo Public Health’s Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias programming. For more information, call (956) 770-1536 or (956) 795-4957.

Source: Laredo Public Health, November 8, 2026.
